items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: We played at the Roseland there. Benny Goodman came down to see us.

ctx.x: We played at the Roseland there. Benny Goodman came down to see us. They had two bands. They had another big band, a sixteen-piece band, but had us as an added attraction. We did shows in San Francisco and Chicago, Los Angeles, Buffalo, New York... Philadelphia at the Bijou Theatre.
